headline: OAK @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.67 at SFG 5.92, with a projected total of 10.59. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: OAK moved -0.14 runs while SFG moved +0.46, changing the projected margin by -0.60 runs. The projected total climbed +0.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Landen Roupp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Casey Schmitt, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas, Matt Chapman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
